主要内容: Royal Bank of Canada completed the sale of RBC General Insurance Company to Aviva Canada Inc., including home and auto insurance manufacturing capabilities. The bank will record a net gain of approximately C$230 million after tax, subject to change, and reflect it in third quarter 2016 results. RBC also signed a 15-year strategic agreement with Aviva Canada Inc., enabling it to market and sell property and casualty insurance products. The bank highlighted risks such as policy changes, tax risk, and environmental risk, cautioning that other factors could affect results. Forward-looking statements regarding financial impacts are subject to risks and uncertainties.
